title: ComputerWorker invokes host start driver once per lease
description: ComputerWorker must call an injected HostStarter once per host_start_generation/lease when nacking for a missing host executor. Retries within the same lease share the claim and must not invoke the driver again. Default implementation is no-op; tests use a recording fake. Optional ECS RunTask client may sit behind env but CDK does not grant ecs:RunTask yet.
